# @mission-platform/forge-router-solid

Forge router target for SolidJS Router

## Installation

Add it to a consuming workspace member:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@mission-platform/forge-router-solid": "workspace:*"
  }
}
```

## Usage

```ts
import { forgeRouterSolid } from '@mission-platform/forge-router-solid';
```
